ContentsItem.description:
Delivered text bound to the exact asset bytes it was rendered from.

Available text names its asset, that asset's sealed digest, its logical path
and the byte span delivered, so the caller can resolve the same bytes again
or verify a quotation without trusting this response. Unavailable items stay
silent: they disclose no asset metadata at all.

SearchExcerpt.description:
One citation: an exact byte span of one asset of one sealed revision.

``asset_digest_sha256`` is absent in retrieval evidence and present in every
delivered citation. The ranker names the span; the digest is bound here from
the revision's sealed descriptor, which is the backend's own authority, so a
projection can never assert which bytes a citation points at. The revision is
on the enclosing hit and the parser version on the enclosing result, which
together make a citation resolvable to exact bytes and re-verifiable later.
SearchExcerpt.title: SearchExcerpt
